headline: Inflation Breaks the Back: Sharp Increase in Food, Petroleum and Electricity Prices
summary: Wholesale inflation rose to 9.92% in August from 9.78% in July, driven by higher food, manufactured goods, fuel and electricity prices. Government data released Monday showed the increase.
why: Wholesale price inflation measures costs at the producer level and is closely watched by the Reserve Bank of India when setting interest rates.
